reply.critique: All five are NYC open mics that welcome music and comedy and have a named venue, a street address and a regular time, and the first is the only dated event, free through NYC Parks. The Boston and New Jersey mics were rightly left out for an NYC artist. Most of these come from a community-kept list that says to confirm with the venue, which the cards already show.
